text:
Ava (ops): Heads up — we received H200 batch from VendorNova at FRA DC. ~8/24 units throwing a thermal-gauge fault on power-on. Photos uploaded: https://redwood-uploads.s3/thermal-2026-03-21 (photos). Need RMA plan ASAP.

Rafael (procurement): Do we have serials? Are these DOA or intermittent? tagging @Maya to confirm.

Maya (logistics): Uploading serial list to the drive and pasting quick summary here: `H200-AX12, H200-BX34, H200-CZ56, H200-DY78, H200-EQ90, H200-FG11, H200-GH22, H200-HI33` — 8 affected. I'll open vendor RMA and check loaner pool.

Jules (sre): Cluster impact: we've drained 2 nodes from eu-edge-1 (in maintenance), net capacity down ~32 vGPU slots. Workloads rebalanced but headroom tight. If replacements delayed >48h, risk of SLA alerts for queued training jobs.

Ava (ops): Rafael, VendorNova quoted 3-5 business days for an air swap (+€2k/unit expedite) or 18-22 days by sea at no extra cost. Need financial signoff for air or push for loaners.

Leo (finance): Emergency air spend approved up to €6k total for this ticket if SRE confirms >SLA risk. Jules, can you confirm impact severity?

Jules (sre): It's medium->high for our burst training customers. Short-term mitigation: throttle batch jobs 25% and migrate non-urgent work to us-west fallback. That should buy ~48 hours. If we can secure loaners overnight we're fine.

Rafael (procurement): I'm negotiating with VendorNova now — pushing for loaner units from their EU pool (no charge). Will request prepaid return labels and a written credit note for any expedited fees if units fail validation after return.

Maya (logistics): Note: temporary import paperwork needed for loaners — mark commercial invoice as 'temporary export/import' and include CN22/DA reference. I'll prep docs; customs at FRA sometimes flags loaners if carrier miscoded.

VendorNova-bot: VendorNova acknowledges RMA request. Preliminary RA# VVN-987654. Proposal: 4 overnight loaners (EU pool), 4 sea replacements. ETA for loaners: 1 business day. Air-swap quote: €1,800/unit incl. duties.

Ava (ops): Nate — can you validate compatibility of loaners (model + firmware) before we accept? Also estimate imaging time.

Nate (eng-ops): Quick check — loaners are H200p, firmware 1.12. We're running 1.14 in prod but H200p is backwards-compatible. We'll need to flash microcode after imaging, ~30min/node. Imaging + QA for 4 units ~3 hours with one tech.

Jules (sre): Ops plan: accept 4 loaners overnight -> image + perf QA -> back in service by EOD tomorrow. We'll tag loaner serials in inventory and create a short runbook for decommissioning when replacements arrive.

Leo (finance): Please log expected cost lines in INF-2026-117. If vendor warranty covers degraded units, we'll recover expedite fees; otherwise charge to ops reserve. Rafael, keep receipts.

Ava (ops): Maya, confirm AWB and pickup window so SRE can schedule imaging crew. Rafael, push vendor for prepaid return labels on sea replacements.

Maya (logistics): AWB: `VVN-EXP-009-1Z` — pickup scheduled 08:30 CET tomorrow. Commercial invoice + temporary import docs uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/workflows/rma/VVN-987654/docs.

Rafael (procurement): Vendor confirmed prepaid returns for the sea replacements and agreed to supply a written credit note for expedited fees if replacements fail within 30 days. I'll add the credit note to the ticket.

Jules (sre): One more ops action — add temporary routing rule to send eu-edge training burst to Milan fallback pool until loaners are live. I'll update the routing config and pin the change to this ticket.

Ava (ops): Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the incident tracker and set a follow-up for 48h. :white_check_mark:
